head.title: Services for finance and HR teams
head.lead: Most clients start with one service and add a second within the first year. Each service has a named account manager and a monthly timetable.

tabs.title: Bookkeeping and management accounts
tabs.text: Our bookkeepers post transactions, reconcile bank accounts and send management accounts by the tenth working day of each month.

photo.alt: Hands on a calculator in front of a laptop with an accounting app

tabs.title: Payroll for weekly and monthly staff
tabs.text: We run weekly and monthly payrolls, handle starters and leavers and send payslips to staff by email on the agreed date.

photo.alt: Woman at a desk with a desk phone and two monitors

tabs.title: HR records, contracts and absence
tabs.text: Our HR team keeps employee records current, drafts contracts from your templates and tracks holidays and absence each month.

photo.alt: Four people working on laptops at a wooden table

cards.title: Accountancy practices
cards.text: Practices that hand over bookkeeping and payroll for their clients during busy months or all year round.

cards.title: Schools and trusts
cards.text: Academies and trusts that need payroll and HR records handled for teaching and support staff.

cards.title: Growing companies
cards.text: Retail, hospitality and service companies with 20 to 500 staff and no in-house finance team.
